rationale_bullets: Lowry is the MAC Offensive POY and the conference's best returning QB tape: 88.6 PFF on 330 snaps (78.2 MAC-adj), 1,803 @ 63% with 9-3, plus 963 rush yds / 14 rush TD - 10-1 as the starter.
System continuity is total: same HC (yr 4), same OC (yr 3), run-first identity built around him.
The cap is real: 6.9 ypa (Athlon: 'could stand to improve') and a depth chart of an Illinois DNP rFr (Petty) and nothing - one injury from crisis.
46 = highest unit grade of the MAC round: clearly above EMU 40/CMU 38 (lesser returning tape), just below FBS-average QB rooms (Nebraska WRTE 50 rail).
Buckley: 79.6 on 178 att (66.3 adj), 1,003 @ 5.6, 3rd-Tm All-MAC - his SECOND 1,000-yd season ('23: 1,003 @ 5.3), closing 193 vs Miami + 174 in the bowl.
Depth is pedigree-real: Cabana (Michigan, PS#18), Green (Arkansas: 964 career @ 4.7), Mataele (252 LY + JC 1,000-yd history).
The 67%-run offense with a 963-yd rushing QB guarantees volume for the room.
28 > Ohio 20 (the round's prior best): only proven returning 1,000-yd back in the MAC round; below the Illinois RB 32 P4 rail.
data_gaps: Green/Cabana have no meaningful recent volume

rationale_bullets: Two of the top three return: Brooks (67.2/246 -> 60.1 adj; 372 @ 13.8) and Chenault (64.2/242 -> 57.1; 277 as a true FR) - real MAC starter production, modest grades.
Nelson (VMI 519 @ 14.8, RS'd '25) has two-print spring buzz; Gouldsby (JC, 5 KR TDs) adds juice; TE1 is a split-print battle of imports (Parks NMSU vs Levicki Presbyterian 783 @ 16.3).
Losses are real but replaceable-tier: T.Williams (478, team lead), TE Bosma, Brescia.
26 = KSU tier: returning production without a proven headliner; below EMU 34, above Buffalo 22. Low-volume pass game caps ceiling and floor.

Three returning 600+ snap starters - Schuster (921, 14 st, 1st-Tm MAC per PS), Dabo (766, 14 st), Whitenack (614, 8 st, ex-Illinois) - PLUS the starting C (Schleicher) back from injury: the most returning OL quality in the MAC round.

The adjusted grades are honest about quality: 40.9-54.4 adj across the returners; PBLK was p19 (masked by Lowry's mobility); the unit's real value is run-blocking (RUN p68) for a 67%-run offense it fits perfectly.
Losses: Anderson (73.1/824 - the line's best player), Vaughan, Vandervest, Hofer (4 OL, 34 starts LY).
Depth adds pedigree (Roebuck-Michigan PS#84, B.Smith-Illinois St 7 st) rather than proof.
28 = CMU tier, just under Miami 30; >> Toledo 14. The continuity is the value; the tape caps it below 30.

The entire seven-man rotation expires via yr4: MAC DPOY Tucker (91.4/579, 14.5 sk, 21 TFL - the highest-graded MAC defender of 2025), McGraw, Fisher, Tyler, Al-Garawi, Lee, Stewart. The p93 PRSH / 43-sack engine is fully gone; PS: 'tough to duplicate.'
Echoles (Ball St: 288 MAC snaps, 78.2 -> 71.8 adj, 3 st) is a genuinely good MAC edge import - the room's one proven piece.

The rest is rotational returners (Frazier 57.2 adj/140, Gustwiller, Gerig) + sub-FBS/pedigree bets: Gardner (LIU 12 st/7 sk - feed-gap), Burley (NAIA), Tibbs (Houston depth; Tucker's JUCO teammate), Tounkara (OSU walk-on RS), Alexander (UNC 11 snaps).
18 = Toledo/EMU/Ohio tier (import-rebuilt front), below KSU 22/CMU 24 (returning FBS tape). Echoles > Toledo's returning scraps, Zock > Echoles as projection - net wash with Toledo.

Returners are low-volume: Moon (82.6 on 136 snaps -> 70.6 adj - excellent grade, reserve role; ex-Purdue) and Moore (57.3/174 -> 45.3).
The re-run of last year's portal trick: Betts (Butler CC: 96 tkl, 4.5 sk - feed-gap) + Anes (Tennessee: 34 snaps, PS#75 pedigree).
TACK p26 says the tackling floor was shaky even WITH the stars.
16 L = Toledo/SacSt/EMU tier. L: the 136-snap lead sample + JUCO/34-snap adds make this the widest evidence gap on the roster.

rationale_bullets: Five returning 350+ snap contributors at 61-66 adj: Franklin (682 snaps; 3rd-Tm MAC; 10 pbu), Sims (695; 13 st; yr4 override, two prints), Peters (353; true-FR nickel buzz), Davis (561; 10 st; ex-Michigan signee), Pope (459; 3 int) - the round's second-best returning secondary volume after Buffalo.
Thomas back on a print-documented medical year (EKU '24: 13 st, 45 tkl, 14 pbu) + adds McCullough (Louisville; Athlon S1), Crump (VMI 173 tkl), Owens (Princeton), two Presbyterian starters.
Losses: Hallock (75.0/790, 2nd-Tm MAC) and Wofford (542 snaps) - the top S and a starting CB.
PS caveat honored: the COV p53 unit 'was aided by a solid pass rush' that no longer exists - grade holds at 30, not higher.
30 > EMU 28/Miami 26, << Buffalo 42.

Both specialist jobs return proven MAC performers: K Domschke (yr4 override, two prints; 13-19 LY with 10-of-13 from 40+; career 22-34 L/52) and P Millmore (2-yr starter; 57 punts, 42.4 / 38.9 net, 11 of 50+; PS#84).
Gouldsby (JC: 5 return TDs in two years) is the best returner-weapon candidate in the MAC round; LS solved via VT import Doyle after losing the incumbent to Oregon.
SPEC 79.2 p74 as-played; PS ST rank #30. The flaw: Domschke's inside-40 accuracy (13-19 overall despite the 40+ split).
28 > KSU/CMU 26, < Miami 40. Proxy 74 = team-grade carryover, not personnel.
